New v0.2 acceptance invariants:
  - statistical sufficiency + effect + confidence do not override a failed cohort-quality gate
  - cohort-quality-failed WEAK_SIGNAL routes to REVIEW_REQUIRED, not behavioural guidance
  - cohort selection/provenance repair is requested before behavioural inference
  - analyzable subset is not silently promoted to source population
  - sample size does not self-authorize representativeness
  - confidence-only WEAK_SIGNAL with sound cohort quality remains OBSERVE_ONLY
  - upstream cohort source / selection / quality reasons survive in full reasoning material
  - convenience or narrow sampling is not automatically moralized as bad

Existing negative guarantees retained:
  - insufficient evidence does not install a style rule
  - materiality-only evidence routes to review, not automatic behaviour change
  - stale evidence does not alter behaviour
  - HIGH_SASS does not imply cancellation causation
  - HIGH_SASS does not imply extreme apology
  - promotional / retention brand context does not create sales authority
  - current sentiment remains explicitly assessed, not factual
  - intervention outcome observation remains ASSOCIATION_ONLY
  - customer identity/raw conversation do not cross the journey bridge
  - free-form customer data cannot hide inside stable evidence-point fields
  - current/previous/long-baseline evidence survives to reasoning material

  Brand Intervention Governance v0.1 complete suite      PASS
